# Mountain Valley Psychological Services, PLLC

> > A comprehensive mental health practice in Carnation, WA providing individual therapy, group programs, diagnostic assessments, and nature-based therapeutic services for children and adults.

Mountain Valley Psychological Services, PLLC operates in the Snoqualmie Valley region of Washington, offering evidence-based psychological services including therapy, diagnostic evaluations for conditions like autism and ADHD, and specialized group programs. The practice combines traditional clinical psychology with nature-based therapeutic approaches at their River Run Ranch location.

## Key Topics

- Individual Therapy
- Group Therapy
- Diagnostic Assessments
- Autism & ADHD Assessment
- Mental Health Services
- Telehealth Services
- Nature-Based Therapy
- Psychological Evaluations
- Snoqualmie Valley
- Crisis Resources
- Courage Camp on the Ranch
- Clinical Psychology
- Mental Health Treatment
